component.name: Lili Crash
component.summary: Find out why a program closed by itself, in plain words
Descubra por que um programa fechou sozinho, em palavras simples

description.p: When a program on your computer crashes, Lili lets you know, and with one click she asks an AI assistant such as Claude Code or Codex to investigate and explain what happened, whether you lost anything, and whether it will happen again.

ul.li: Notifies every program that crashes, from systemd-coredump
Notices when the whole computer froze and tells you what happened right before
Notices a Steam game that closes by itself right after starting
Notices an app that won't open and shows the first thing it complained about
Shows your AI usage limits next to the clock on KDE Plasma
Lives in the system tray on GNOME, XFCE, Cinnamon and other desktops
Can diagnose with a local AI through Ollama, so nothing leaves your computer

ul.li: A lily logo in the theme's colours, a tray icon on every desktop, a local AI through Ollama, and setup at first login
